messages:
maria: customer reporting 400 on structured tool call to `order_parser` when they omit the optional `notes` field. request_id=01GZQ9ABCD1234. they say it used to work yesterday.
samir: can you paste the full request_id and the raw request/response? also which model + runtime version? quick guess: schema validation treating absent != null.
jess: @samir good call. debug-bot can collect a debug bundle if you need logs + kernel traces. @maria can you generate the bundle or should we ask the customer?
maria: full request id: `01GZQ9ABCD1234`. here's the trimmed server log around the failure (sanitized):
```
2026-03-16T22:11:05Z INFO request received id=01GZQ9ABCD1234 route=/v1/toolcall model=redwood-2.3
2026-03-16T22:11:06Z ERROR validation_failed id=01GZQ9ABCD1234 err="structured_toolcall: missing required property \"notes\""
2026-03-16T22:11:06Z DEBUG response 400 id=01GZQ9ABCD1234 body="{\"error\":{\"type\":\"validation_error\",\"message\":\"missing required property 'notes'\"}}"
```
They attached a short curl they used originally (customer removed auth):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/toolcall \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <$REDACTED>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"tool":"order_parser","input":{"order_id":"A123"}}'
```
samir: thanks. I reproduced locally with a quick curl against staging and got same 400. local response:
```
HTTP/1.1 400 Bad Request
{
  "error": {
    "type": "validation_error",
    "message": "'notes' is required",
    "validation": {"path":"input.items[0].notes","required":true}
  }
}
```
samir: repro steps I used:
1) use the customer's payload exactly
2) set `Authorization` header with a staging token
3) POST to /v1/toolcall
curl repro:
```
curl -s -X POST https://staging-api.redwood.ai/v1/toolcall \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $STAGING_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"tool":"order_parser","input":{"order_id":"A123"}}'
```
obs-bot: debug bundle created: https://debug.redwood/s/abcd1234 (contains request id 01GZQ9ABCD1234, runtime logs, kernel traces). retention: 7d.
jess: temporary workaround for customers: include `"notes": null` in the `input` object or explicitly pass empty string depending on downstream app. I'll mark this P2 and ask eng-runtime for a short patch.
eng-runtime: digging in — looks like a change in the schema validator rolled in yesterday that flips semantics: absent field is now treated as missing even if schema previously allowed `null`. root cause: our generated JSON schema omitted `"nullable": true` on the `notes` property for some tool schemas when transpiling from internal proto. pushing PR to restore `nullable` flag.
eng-runtime: quick mitigation: patch route to accept either absent or null for now. ETA for patch: ~3 hours. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/472
samir: will communicate to the customer: we have a mitigation and a patch coming, and we have the debug bundle if they want us to attach. question: permission to attach debug bundle to the customer ticket (it contains sanitized logs)?
maria: yes please attach, go ahead. i'll tell customer to add `"notes": null` for now. thanks :thumbsup:
jess: leaving a checklist for the support ticket: 1) attach debug bundle link 2) add repro curl 3) note patched ETA 4) followup when PR merged :eyes:
